text: In the old logging camps of the north woods, lumberjacks whispered about something after dark.
No one ever saw it. Because no matter how fast you turned around... it was already behind you.
One night, a logger walked back to camp alone.
Crack. A branch snapped behind him. He turned. Nothing.
He walked faster. Something behind him walked faster too.
Silence. Then breathing... right behind his neck.
He turned around. Slowly. And this time... it didn't hide.
By morning, the men found only his lantern on the trail. The camp knew what had taken him.
So if you're ever in the woods at night... and you hear something behind you... keep walking.
